decided: 2026-11-23, user chose option A (names-only seed picking, questions from 2-5 file fixes, five first)
rule: eligible candidates with at least 3 changed non-test Go lines and 2..5 changed non-test Go files, sorted by files descending, date descending, fix hash; first 5. A candidate the author agent rejects is replaced by the next reserve.
seed_rule: One agent per question. It gets the symptom sentence and one text file listing declaration names (kind, name, file) of the base graph without tests; no source code.
stop_line: Widen only if at most 2 of the 5 questions have every core location among the seeds. Claude set this line before the run.
publication: Symptom sentences and labels stay outside the repo until the run is over; the repo holds their sha256.
